podcast.body: Featured on "The Man-Machine," this song exemplifies the band's identity as "robots" and their embrace of mechanization. It contributed to the album's success in popularizing electronic dance music and showcased their unique, dehumanized yet catchy approach to pop. "funcionó nindos del Dance Pop como Translíope Express, showroom dumis, de model, de robots, Crafwerke había logrado lo que muchas artistas llevaban años señando."
